hotel_name: Higashiyama Niseko Village, a Ritz Carlton Reserve

claims.text: The hotel is at 919-28 Aza Soga, Niseko cho, Abuta gun, Niseko, Hokkaido, Japan.

findings.quote: 919-28 Aza Soga, Niseko cho, Abuta gun, Niseko, Hokkaido, Japan, 048-1522

claims.text: Floor-to-ceiling windows in the rooms and suites look out over Mount Yotei or Niseko Annupuri.

findings.quote: Floor-to-ceiling windows look out over Mount Yotei or Niseko Annupuri
findings.note: Stated for resort rooms and suites

claims.text: Guest bathrooms are inspired by the local onsen tradition, with an oversized soaking tub, a separate rainforest shower and a large window with a mountain view.

findings.quote: the guest bathrooms are inspired by the local onsen tradition, featuring an oversized soaking tub, separate rainforest shower and large window offering natural light and a mountain view.

claims.text: Yukibana is an all-day restaurant overlooking Mount Yotei, with locally sourced ingredients and a farm-to-table concept.

findings.quote: An all-day dining restaurant overlooking the beautiful Mount Yotei. Offers meals with locally sourced ingredients, highlights of international cuisine, Asian and healthy delicacies, and a farm-to-table concept.

claims.text: Ume Lounge has a fireplace and serves classic cocktails customised by an alpine mixologist.

findings.quote: Unwind by the cosy fireplace with a classic cocktail customised by our alpine mixologist.

claims.text: The onsen has hot indoor and outdoor baths, separate for ladies and gentlemen, with tranquil gardens and saunas.

findings.quote: The hot indoor and outdoor baths, separate for ladies and gentlemen, are overlooked by the mountainous landscape and feature tranquil gardens and saunas.

claims.text: The hotel sits at the base of Mount Annupuri, with gondola access to the slopes.

findings.quote: At the base of Mount Annupuri, the hotel is perfectly positioned for guests to jump straight on a gondola and onto the slopes
findings.note: Editorial page covers base and gondola

claims.text: Summer activities include hiking, cycling and horseback riding.

findings.quote: including hiking, cycling and horseback riding, guests can experience a thrilling adventure

claims.text: Two 18-hole golf courses are near the resort.

findings.quote: Moments from our Niseko Village resort, two 18-hole golf courses challenge players

claims.text: The Niseko Village Kids Club welcomes children aged 1.5 to 9 years.

findings.quote: the Niseko Village Kids Club offers an enriching experience for children aged 1.5 to 9 years.

claims.text: A Do San, meaning person of Hokkaido, joins each guest as a single point of contact.

findings.quote: A Do San joins each guest on their resort journey, offering a single point of contact for every wish, want or need. Meaning “person of Hokkaido,”

claims.text: The hotel's Higashiyama Reservists, a team of mountain experts, create curated ski adventures.

findings.quote: the resort’s team of mountain experts create curated ski adventures

claims.text: Spa Chasi La Sothys blends Japanese tradition with French techniques and has private onsens.

findings.quote: treatments that blend Japanese tradition with French techniques, plus boasts luxurious features like private onsens

claims.text: Sushi Nagi serves omakase-style sushi, with menus featuring local seafood and farm-sourced ingredients.

findings.quote: Presented omakase-style, menus feature local seafood and farm-sourced ingredients.

claims.text: Seven of the suites can be interconnected to adjacent rooms for larger family groups.

findings.quote: Seven of the suites can be interconnected to adjacent rooms for larger family groups.

claims.text: The closest airport is New Chitose Airport in Sapporo, about 113.8 km from the hotel.

findings.quote: The closest airport near Higashiyama Niseko Village, a Ritz-Carlton Reserve is New Chitose Airport - Sapporo (CTS). CTS is located approximately 113.8 KM from the hotel.

claims.text: Pets are not allowed at the hotel.

findings.quote: No, pets are not allowed at Higashiyama Niseko Village, a Ritz-Carlton Reserve.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes ultra-luxury pricing reflecting Reserve-level positioning.
